highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews Skia m154 and ships compiler-generated XML documentation with its packages.
highlights_body: HarfBuzzSharp bindings now follow the bundled native source; review the enum migrations below before upgrading.

breaking.title: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 renamed
breaking.body: The misspelled CCC133 member is corrected to CCC132 while retaining numeric value 132. Update source code that references CCC133 to use CCC132 instead.

breaking.title: GlyphFlags.Defined removed
breaking.body: The aggregate GlyphFlags.Defined mask is no longer exposed. Combine the concrete glyph flags your application requires directly; the analogous BufferFlags.Defined and SerializeFlag.Defined members are not added.

bullets.lead: Skia updated through Chrome m154 servicing
bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 154 and incorporates upstream rendering and buffer-upload fixes.
NuGet packages now include compiler-generated XML documentation, with API descriptions maintained alongside the C# declarations.

contributor_summaries.azchohfi: Improved the Windows binary-analysis configuration for the HarfBuzzSharp native package

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 opened the 4.154 line with the Skia m154 engine update.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp bindings now generate from the HarfBuzz revision bundled by Skia, keeping supported declarations synchronized with the native library.

v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m154 engine update.
v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.body: It also begins the release line's compiler XML documentation and bundled HarfBuzz binding updates.
